newsitem.title: USA: Riscorp says executives subpoenaed in probe.
newsitem.headline: Riscorp says executives subpoenaed in probe.

text.p: Riscorp Inc said Thursday that it and two of its executive officers have been subpoenaed by a federal grand jury investigating political contributions.
The company said it is cooperating in the investigation, and does not believe it will have a "material effect" on its financial condition or operating results.
Riscorp, a managed care workers' compensation company, described the investigation as a "broad examination" of political candidates and campaign contributions.
The company did not say where the grand jury is located. It also did not name the two executives who have been subpoenaed.
Riscorp said it "understands that a number of other parties unrelated to the company also have been served with subpoenas."
The company did not immediately return a telephone call seeking more information.
A company spokesman said the confidentiality rules governing such investigations barred him from disclosing the location of the grand jury and the names of the executives who have been subpoenaed.
